newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products follow crude lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products follow crude lower.

text.p: NWE oil products eased on Monday as they played catch-up with crude future losses on Friday.
High sulphur barges were softer, traded once at $86 a tonne before the market was thinly talked with sellers at about $86.50 and with little buying interest at $85.

Eurograde gasoline barges traded at $188 a tonne fob AR and $189 fob ARA some $7-$8 below the weakest deal on Friday. Sloppy supplies were overhanging the market. Naphtha was off on crude. June swaps were quoted at $179.50/$181.50.
Gas oil eased with benchmark IPE futures which shed around $3.0. Heating oil barges traded at June IPE +$1.0 fob Rott.
